data.name: SummaryText
data.value: UI/UX developer shipping software since 2018, with deep C#, WPF, .NET, XAML and MVVM experience. At Creaform, I modernize Creaform.OS interfaces and reusable UI components; I designed and implemented nearly all of the new peel.OS interface. Professional photography since 2010 and Photoshop practice since 2001 inform my visual judgment. For personal products, including this website and Prompt Prisme, Claude Code and Codex are my main implementation tools: I define the product and interactions, direct the work, review the code and validate the result. My web work uses Astro, TypeScript and Cloudflare; React, JavaScript and Redux experience comes from Arcane (2018–2020). Seeking hands-on UI/UX and product development roles that combine design responsibility with coding-agent production workflows.
